# Arachnids
## General information
Their webbing provides them with two additional pockets for item storage.
Their strong fangs make their unarmed attacks deal Piercing damage, rather than Blunt.
Their animal-like digestive systems can process raw meat and blood without any ill effects, but are poisoned by chemicals such as allicin (found in garlic and onions) and theobromine (found in caffeinated beverages and chocolate).
Their blue blood is copper-based, and is therefore replenished by metabolizing copper, rather than iron.
They [color=#ffa500]suffocate 50% faster[/color].
## Sericulture
Arachnids can create websilk at the cost of getting more hungry. They (and only they) can craft bundles of websilk into various items, such as clothing, shields, furniture, and even entire walls.
